description: Lists the papers of one author record from Semantic Scholar or ORCID, a page at a time.
Finds author records by name in Semantic Scholar.
Reads author records by their Semantic Scholar or ORCID ID, in the order you give.
Counts the ChEMBL assays recorded for one cell line.
Finds cell lines by name in Cellosaurus.
Reads one cell line by its ID, and optionally one named section such as its variants.
Reads one GWAS Catalog association or study, and optionally its loci, associations or ancestries.
Finds GWAS Catalog associations by trait, gene, variant, study or PubMed ID, smallest p-value first.
Lists UniProt features of one protein, five at a time, filtered by type or residue.
Lists the isoforms of one protein, five at a time.
Lists the InterPro domains of one protein, five at a time.
Lists the Complex Portal complexes that hold one protein, five at a time.
Lists the members of one Complex Portal complex that holds the protein, five at a time.
Lists the PDB structures of one protein, five at a time.
Prints the whole amino-acid sequence of one UniProt protein or isoform.
Finds reviewed human UniProt proteins by text or by gene, five at a time.
Reads UniProt protein records by accession, and optionally sections such as domains or sequence.
Finds Human Phenotype Ontology (HP) terms by text in HPO or Monarch.
Reads one HP term from HPO or Monarch, and optionally its synonyms, links, related diseases or genes.
Finds human pathways in Reactome, the default, or WikiPathways.
Reads one Reactome or WikiPathways pathway, and optionally its summary, genes or events.
Lists the genes and gene products of one pathway.
Lists the events, such as reactions, of one Reactome pathway.
Finds cBioPortal studies by text in a downloaded copy of the study list.
Reads one cBioPortal study, and optionally its profiles, sample lists or files.
Finds CPIC gene-drug pairs for a gene.
Reads pharmacogenomic records from CPIC or ClinPGx, such as guidelines, recommendations or annotations.
Finds diagnostic tests in one source, such as GTR, the FDA companion diagnostic list or WHO's prequalified tests.
Reads one diagnostic test record, and optionally one section such as its genes or conditions.
Finds adverse event reports in FAERS, VAERS or MAUDE, five at a time.
Reads one adverse event report by its ID, and optionally one section such as its drugs or reactions.
Finds disease concepts by text, or lists SEER cancer sites.
Reads one disease concept or SEER cancer site, and optionally a section such as its genes or incidence.
Finds drugs by name in one source.
Reads one drug record by its ID in one source, and optionally a section such as its label or approvals.
Reads one to twenty human genes, in the order you give, and optionally sections such as constraint or expression.
Finds human genes by text, by cytoband, or both.
Finds articles by text, gene, disease, drug, variant, author, journal or date.
Reads one to twenty articles by PMID, PMCID or DOI, and optionally sections such as the full text.
Reads one supplementary file of an article, or the rows of it that match a search, or saves the file.
Downloads an article's PDF from its publisher to a file you name.
Reads one part of an article's full text, finds matching passages, or saves the text as Markdown.
Lists the papers that cite one PubMed article, a page at a time.
Lists the papers one PubMed article cites, a page at a time.
Shows where and how one article cites another, with the citing passage when the full text is open.
Lists papers that Semantic Scholar recommends from one or more seed papers.
Finds clinical trials in ClinicalTrials.gov, the default, or NCI, by condition, drug, gene, location and more.
Reads clinical trials by NCT ID, and optionally sections such as eligibility or locations.
Downloads one document a trial posted on ClinicalTrials.gov, such as its protocol PDF, to a file you name.
Lists the assertions one source, such as ClinVar, makes about a variant, a page at a time.
Reads a variant by rsID, ClinVar ID, ClinGen allele ID or HGVS, and optionally sections such as ClinVar or population.
Lists gnomAD population frequency details for one variant.
Finds variants by gene, protein change, region or another single selector.
Counts the samples that carry one variant in one cBioPortal study.
Sends an HGVS variant name to the ClinGen Allele Registry, Mutalyzer or VariantValidator to check and normalize it.
Shows the agent guide and worked examples built into BioMCP.
Lists the worked examples built into BioMCP.
Prints the whole agent guide.
Reports whether the guide installed in a folder is missing, changed, out of date or current.
Installs the agent guide into a folder.
Prints the version; --verbose adds the commit it was built from, the schema IDs and the paths BioMCP uses.
Prints the configuration an MCP client needs to start BioMCP.
Removes expired replies and stored searches from the local cache.
Lists every source with its terms and checks that each one answers.
Downloads a source's bundle, a local copy that commands read.
Prints one reply schema as JSON Schema.
Prints the help for every command, or for one, as JSON.
Lists the keys BioMCP supports and where each one is set, without showing values.
Stores a key for one source, read from a hidden prompt or standard input.
Removes a stored key.
Runs BioMCP as an MCP server over standard input and output, or over HTTP.
Downloads the WikiPathways bundle that pathway searches read.
Downloads the cBioPortal study list bundle that study commands read.
Downloads the European Medicines Agency bundle that EMA drug commands read.
Downloads the DDInter drug interaction bundle.
Downloads the WHO prequalified medicines bundle.
Downloads the Genetic Testing Registry bundle that diagnostic commands read.
Downloads the WHO prequalified diagnostics bundle.
Downloads the FDA companion diagnostics bundle.
Shows how to set the NCBI key: the key name and its environment variable.

Shows how to set the ORCID key: the key name and its environment variable.
